source_pressure_theorem.linear_subdominant_port: The eight degree-one source chaoses obey the product hypercontractive/Duhamel estimates with exponent 4/3; finite label multiplicity changes constants only and yields cutoff-, rectangle- and boundary-uniform two-sided pressure bounds on compact J balls.
source_pressure_theorem.all_source_limit: For every constant J in R8, all Section-VIII covariance/Wick pressures p_A^(X;Y) have one finite thermodynamic limit p(J) through rectangles whose two side lengths tend independently to infinity, locally uniformly in J.
source_pressure_theorem.convexity: Finite-volume log moment-generating functions are convex; local-uniform convergence preserves convexity.
source_pressure_theorem.evenness: The centered Gaussian law and even Q3 interaction are invariant under Phi->-Phi, so p_A(J)=p_A(-J) and p(J)=p(-J).
source_pressure_theorem.origin: p(0)=alpha_infinity>0 in the fixed scalar-removed convention of EXP-000778.

phase_diagnostic.directional_response: For f_v(h)=p(hv), m_v=f_v'(0+) exists, is finite and nonnegative, while f_v'(0-)=-m_v.
phase_diagnostic.cusp: m_v>0 is exactly a pressure-level cusp in source direction v; no sign is proved for any actual Q3 direction.
phase_diagnostic.finite_volume: Every finite symmetric volume has derivative zero at h=0. The thermodynamic limit must precede h->0; use difference quotients, not an unjustified exchange of pressure derivatives.
phase_diagnostic.underdetermination: alpha+m log cosh(h) and alpha+m|h| are finite convex even growth-compatible pressure controls with the same value at zero and different cusp behavior; moreover log cosh(nh)/n converges locally uniformly to |h| with error at most log(2)/n while every approximant has zero derivative at zero, so p(0) and finite-volume zero response alone cannot classify a phase.
phase_diagnostic.state_boundary: A cusp does not by itself construct, identify, prove purity of, or prove clustering for plus/minus states; m_v=0 in all directions also does not alone prove uniqueness of every state.

physical_reference_no_go.mutation: u_J->u_J+c gives Z_A,c(J)=exp(-c|A|)Z_A(J), p_c(J)=p(J)-c and raw energy density shifted by +c.
physical_reference_no_go.invariants: Normalized Gibbs/KMS states, correlations, KL divergence and p(J)-p(0) are unchanged.
physical_reference_no_go.required_external_data: A physical below-empty-space statement needs an independently selected reference on the same algebra and geometry, a common renormalized stress tensor, and an observable or cosmological-constant renormalization condition.

parent_reduction_no_go.marginal: For S(q,r)=a(q^2+r^2)/2+b(q^4/2+3q^2r^2+r^4/2), the exact effective action is S(q,0)+F(q^2)-F(0), where F'(s)=3b E_s[r^2]>0 and F''(s)=-9b^2 Var_s(r^2)<0; the discarded-mode correction is nonconstant.
parent_reduction_no_go.consequence: The two-cell block refutes the inference that agreement on a transverse-zero restriction alone establishes the interacting Euclidean or quantum marginal. A constraint, decoupling theorem, dressed embedding or exact effective-action/RG result is required.
parent_reduction_no_go.boundary: The control block does not calculate the full ST8/Q3LOCK marginal, exclude cancellations in a full effective action, rule out every dimensional reduction, or refute the finite ST8/Q3LOCK candidate.
